name: tether
description: Drive a remote Windows machine through Claude Code via a one-shot agent .exe and a cloud relay. Filesystem, shell, registry, event log, screenshots, clipboard, Active Directory, and window control without installing anything beyond the .exe on the remote.

tether.description: Tether MCP server. Spawned via launch-tether-mcp.ps1 so the binary is guaranteed to exist before MCP initialize (races SessionStart otherwise).
